_meta.xpTable: Classic Era / vanilla 1-60 XP-to-next (warcraft.wiki.gg Experience to level; wowcalc.net Classic). Per-level values in xpTableValues (index 0 unused). Cumulative 1→60 = 4084700.
_meta.method: Turn-in questId looked up in content/questie-db/quests.json (web/public/data/quests.json absent). Credit once per quest per route. Floor to pack min level at each pack start. Primary shared-path race = Undead.
_meta.enterBarrensNote: Undead includes tirisfal-1-12 then silverpine-11-15. Orc/Troll = durotar-1-12 end. Tauren = mulgore-1-12 end. Skyborne = zephras-isle end. Offsets = race − Undead on the balanced clock at Barrens entry only; after the barrens pack floor (12) stay on the stored Undead estLevel.
notes: estLevel is quest-turnin XP only (accept/complete do not grant XP). Kill, explore, and discovery XP are omitted, so 1-12 packs end near 9–10 instead of 12.
Each pack floors XP to its declared min level at pack start (silverpine 11, barrens 12, 20-40 20, 40-60 40). That matches authored handoff text ('start at the Crossroads, level 20').

Balanced includes steps whose routes contain 'balanced' (bonus-style steps are routes:['balanced'] only; no step.bonus field exists in these packs). Speedrun ignores those steps and does not receive their XP.

Shared packs (barrens-12-20, horde-20-40, horde-40-60) store a single estLevel on the Undead path (tirisfal + silverpine + shared). Other races add header enterBarrensOffsets (balanced, vs Undead at Barrens entry).

durotar step estLevel uses the Orc path; Troll is in enterBarrens. Class-gated steps (step.classes set) are listed but their quest XP is skipped so one character is not credited with every class quest.
Race filters are Filter.any AND-groups from contracts/schema.ts (`race` on a term). Pack default is used when a step has no filter. Skyborne is the profile key for Windshaper.
Steps with dungeon, dungeonsOff, or tags.dungeonId are omitted (old end-of-pack dungeon blocks).
Zone is the latest goto.at.zone (or a known zone name in a type:zone label) carried forward within the pack only.
9 turn-ins in quests.json have no xp field; XP interpolated from quest level (Classic full-reward knots). See estimatedXp.
enterBarrens uses the balanced clock. Speedrun values at Barrens entry are in enterBarrensSpeedrun.
mergeLevel is the highest enterBarrens value among the five starts.
Anchors are splice-friendly: pack start, flight, inn/hearth, zeppelin, capital, newly entered hub, or section boundary.

enterBarrens is the 1-12/silverpine finish (quest XP, no kills). Shared packs then floor to 12/20/40. Use offsets only at Barrens entry; after the barrens floor treat all races as on the Undead estLevel clock.

calibration.use: planners must use estLevel.calibrated, not the raw quest-XP estLevel.balanced / estLevel.speedrun
calibration.formula: bandStart + (est - estAtFirstStep) / (estAtLastStep - estAtFirstStep) * (bandEnd - bandStart); denom 0 -> step-index fraction; round 2dp; clamp to band
